themes_detail.label: Park Noise & Rule Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Park-related complaints have spiked dramatically THIS WEEK, with noise complaints up 567% (10 complaints this week vs. 1.5 weekly average) and park rule violations up 967% (4 complaints this week vs. 0.4 weekly average), suggesting a possible enforcement gap or event-driven disruption in Jackson Heights–Corona Park or similar green spaces.
evidence: Noise - Park complaints: 10 this week vs. 1.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.39, +567%)
Violation of Park Rules complaints: 4 this week vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, +967%)
Community Board repeatedly requests park maintenance and safety funding, suggesting chronic neglect
reporting_angles: Visit Jackson Heights–Corona Park to observe conditions, interview Parks Dept and community residents about what triggered the spike
Cross-reference 311 data with Parks Dept incident logs, events calendar, or staffing changes this week

themes_detail.label: Elevator Infrastructure Crisis in Buildings
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints surged 404% LAST WEEK (17 complaints vs. 3.4 weekly average, z-score 7.05), a sharp spike indicating potential systemic breakdowns in residential or commercial elevators that could trap elderly or disabled residents and warrant DOB inspection coordination.
evidence: Elevator complaints: 17 last week vs. 3.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.05, +404%)
308 DOB building permits filed in past 90 days, including 250 alterations and 30 ALT-COs, suggesting active construction that may be disrupting elevator service
Community Board requests 'Other expense budget request for DOB,' indicating ongoing building code/inspection gaps
reporting_angles: Query DOB for which buildings had elevator complaints and cross-check against active permits; are contractors blocking access?
Interview residents in multi-family buildings about wait times and accessibility impacts, especially for seniors

themes_detail.label: Litter and Street Cleanliness Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Litter Basket Requests spiked 700% TWO WEEKS AGO (7 complaints vs. 0.9 weekly average, z-score 7.85), and Dirty Condition complaints remain elevated at 311 in the past 90 days, suggesting sanitation services or street maintenance have contracted or been redirected.
evidence: Litter Basket Request complaints: 7 two weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 7.85, +700%)
Dirty Condition complaints: 311 total in last 90 days, third most common sanitation complaint after parking and blocked driveways
Community Board repeats 'Other capital budget request for DEP' and park maintenance requests, indicating chronic underfunding of street/park cleanliness
reporting_angles: Check if Sanitation Dept reassigned crews away from this district; compare collection schedules to adjacent CDs
Walk major corridors in Elmhurst, Jackson Heights, Corona and document litter conditions; interview residents about visibility of street cleaning

themes_detail.label: Green Taxi Complaint Anomaly
themes_detail.summary: Green Taxi complaints exploded 1100% LAST WEEK (3 complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average, z-score 4.16), an unusual spike that may reflect a single problematic operator, illegal taxi activity, or a new enforcement push worth investigating.
evidence: Green Taxi Complaint: 3 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 4.16, +1100%)
Spike is isolated to one week, suggesting single incident or operator rather than district-wide pattern
reporting_angles: Pull 311 complaint details to identify specific addresses or streets; trace complaints back to individual medallion or operator
Contact TLC to confirm whether they've issued citations or received reports from Jackson Heights–Elmhurst in the past week

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Dead/Dying Tree complaints jumped 264% TWO WEEKS AGO (5 complaints vs. 1.4 weekly average, z-score 4.23), indicating possible disease outbreak, storm damage, or chronic underwatering that aligns with the Community Board's repeated park maintenance requests.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 5 two weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 4.23, +264%)
Community Board repeatedly requests 'Other park maintenance and safety requests' and 'Other capital budget request for DEP,' suggesting chronic neglect of green infrastructure
Street Condition complaints total 1,200 in past 90 days, indicating broader infrastructure maintenance lag
reporting_angles: Identify which streets/parks have the most dead trees and determine if there's a common cause (disease, drought stress, pests, or storm damage)
Interview Parks Dept about tree inspection and watering schedules; compare to other CDs to see if Jackson Heights–Elmhurst is underserved
